cues.zh: 拼命干，没有捷径可走。去健身房让我抓狂。如果你每天读一小时书
cues.en: Work your ass off there is no magic pill. It drives me crazy to go to the gym. If you read one hour a day

cues.zh: 我每天锻炼五小时，同时还在做建筑工作
cues.en: I went and worked out five hours a day, and I was working on construction

cues.zh: 我们一天有24小时，安排好你的一天，努力干
cues.en: We have 24 hours a day, organize your day, work hard

cues.zh: 我来这里是想谈谈成功
cues.en: I'm here to talk about success

cues.zh: 我上了大学
cues.en: I went to college

cues.zh: 我每天锻炼五小时，同时还在做建筑工作
cues.en: I went and worked out five hours a day and I was working on construction

cues.zh: 因为当年健美这行根本没钱赚
cues.en: Because in those days in bodybuilding, there was no money

cues.zh: 我连买营养补剂之类的钱都没有，所以我得去工作，于是我就干起了建筑
cues.en: I didn't have the money for food supplements or anything. So I had to go to work. So I worked in construction

cues.zh: 我上大学，在健身房锻炼，晚上从8点到午夜12点
cues.en: I went to college I worked out in the gym and at night from 8 o'clock at night to 12 midnight

cues.zh: 我去上表演课
cues.en: I went to acting class

cues.zh: 每周四次
cues.en: four times a week

cues.zh: 我全都做到了
cues.en: I did all that

cues.zh: 我一分钟都没有浪费过
cues.en: There was not one single minute that I wasted

cues.zh: 这就是为什么今天我站在这里
cues.en: And this is why I'm standing here today

cues.zh: 20岁时我去了伦敦，赢得了环球先生大赛，成为史上最年轻的环球先生
cues.en: At the age of 20 I went to London and I won the Mr Universe contest as the youngest Mr Universe ever

cues.zh: 那是因为我有一个目标
cues.en: and it was because I had a goal

cues.zh: 如果你对自己要去哪里没有愿景
cues.en: If you don't have a vision of where you go

cues.zh: 如果你没有前进的目标，你就会四处漂泊，最终一事无成
cues.en: And if you don't have a goal where you go, you drift around and you never end up anywhere

cues.zh: 美国有74%的人讨厌自己的工作
cues.en: 74% of the people hate their job in America

cues.zh: 大多数人不喜欢自己正在做的事
cues.en: The majority of people don't like what they're doing

cues.zh: 因为他们其实并不是真心在做，因为他们没有目标，也没有追随这个目标
cues.en: Because they are really not doing it because they didn't have a goal and followed this goal

cues.zh: 他们只是漫无目的地漂泊，然后有个职位空缺，他们就得到了那份工作，因为你总得工作
cues.en: They're just aimlessly drift around and then there's a job opening so they get their job because you have to work

cues.zh: 但一旦把它当成差事
cues.en: But then when you work it's a chore

cues.zh: 那就是工作
cues.en: It's work

cues.zh: 就不好玩了
cues.en: It's not fun

cues.zh: 想想看，生活中只有四分之一的人真正享受自己在做的事
cues.en: So if you think about only a quarter of the people really enjoy what they're doing in life

cues.zh: 所以人们总问我
cues.en: So people always ask me

cues.zh: 当年我在健身房练举重的时候，他们看到我就问，你为什么练得这么拼命？
cues.en: When they saw me in the gym in the pumping iron days, they say why is it that you're working out so hard?

cues.zh: 一天五六个小时，脸上却总是挂着笑容
cues.en: Five hours a day six hours a day and you have always a smile on your face

cues.zh: 别人练得跟你一样苦，脸上却一脸苦相
cues.en: The others are working out just as hard as you do and they look sour in the face

cues.zh: 这是为什么？
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 我一直告诉人们，因为对我来说，我是在朝着一个目标冲刺
cues.en: And I told people all the time because to me I am shooting for a goal

cues.zh: 我眼前就是环球先生的头衔
cues.en: In front of me is the Mr Universe title

cues.zh: 所以我每做一次动作，都让我离实现这个目标更近一步，让这个愿景变成现实
cues.en: So every rep that I do gets me closer to accomplishing the goal to make this goal, this vision turn into reality

cues.zh: 我做的每一组
cues.en: Every single set that I do

cues.zh: 每一次重复、举起的每一块重量，都让我离把目标变成现实更近一步
cues.en: Every repetition every weight that i lift will get me a step closer to turning this goal into reality

cues.zh: 所以我迫不及待想再做一次500磅深蹲，迫不及待想再做一次500磅卧推
cues.en: So I couldn't wait to do another 500 pound squat. I couldn't wait to do another 500 pound benchpress

cues.zh: 迫不及待想再做2000个仰卧起坐，迫不及待想练下一个动作
cues.en: I couldn't wait to do another 2,000 reps of sit-ups. I couldn't wait for the next exercise

cues.zh: 所以让我告诉你，把目标可视化并去追求它，就会变得有趣
cues.en: So let me tell you something visualizing your goal and going after it makes it fun

cues.zh: 无论你做什么，都得有个目标。你必须要有目标
cues.en: You got to have a purpose no matter what you do in life. You got to have the purpose

cues.zh: 穆罕默德·阿里
cues.en: Mohammed Ali

cues.zh: 拼尽了全力
cues.en: Worked his butt off

cues.zh: 我亲眼所见
cues.en: And I saw it firsthand

cues.zh: 记住，当时有个体育记者
cues.en: Now remember that there was a sports writer

cues.zh: 就在健身房里，阿里在训练，他在做仰卧起坐
cues.en: That was there in the gym, and he was working out he was doing situps

cues.zh: 他问他，你做多少个仰卧起坐？
cues.en: And asked him how many sit-ups do you do?

cues.zh: 他说，我不到疼的时候不开始数
cues.en: And he said I don't start counting until it hurts

cues.zh: 想想看，他做仰卧起坐不到感觉疼的时候不开始数
cues.en: Now think about that, he doesn't start counting his situps and he feels pain

cues.zh: 那时候他才开始数
cues.en: That's when he starts counting

cues.zh: 那才叫努力
cues.en: That is working hard

cues.zh: 所以努力是绕不过去的，不管是谁都一样
cues.en: And so you can't get around the hard work, it doesn't matter who it is

cues.zh: 拼命干。没有什么灵丹妙药
cues.en: Work your ass off. There is no magic pill

cues.zh: 世上没有什么魔法
cues.en: There is no magic out there

cues.zh: 你绕不过去，你必须干啊干啊干
cues.en: You cannot get around you have to work and work and work

cues.zh: 你得确保这些事都做到位。所以就是干
cues.en: You have this make sure of that in order stuff. So it's work

cues.zh: 有人说我没时间，这让我抓狂
cues.en: And it drives me crazy when people say that I don't have enough time

cues.zh: 没时间去健身房
cues.en: To go to the gym

cues.zh: 每天45分钟锻炼
cues.en: For 45 minutes a day and work out

cues.zh: 或者每天花45分钟到一小时做点什么来提升自己，不管是身体上的提升还是精神上的提升
cues.en: Or to do something for 45 minutes to an hour a day to improve if it is physically improve or if it is mentally to improve

cues.zh: 想象你每天读一小时书
cues.en: Imagine you read one hour a day

cues.zh: 读历史
cues.en: About history

cues.zh: 365个小时之后……一年下来你能学到多少
cues.en: How much you will learn after 365 hours... in one year

cues.zh: 想想如果你研究音乐家、作曲家的历史，你能懂多少？
cues.en: Think about if you study about the history of musicians of composers how much you would know?

cues.zh: 想象一下，如果你每天花一小时在你想要发展的业务上
cues.en: Imagine if you would work on the business and some business that you want to develop every day for an hour

cues.zh: 想象一下你能走多远、取得多大进展
cues.en: imagine how further along you will go and get

cues.zh: 这让我抓狂，因为人们总说自己没时间。我们一天有24小时
cues.en: So it drives me nuts because when people say they don't have the time. We have 24 hours a day

cues.zh: 我们每天睡六小时，那你还剩18小时
cues.en: We sleep six hours a day. So that gives you still 18 hours

cues.zh: 前排有人在摇头，大概是想说我不止睡6小时，我睡8小时，对吧？
cues.en: There's someone shaking the head out here in front to say probably I don't sleep 6 hours. I sleep eight hours, right?

cues.zh: 那就睡快点。我们一天有18小时，普通人工作大约8到10小时
cues.en: Or just sleep faster. So we have 18 hours a day. The average person works around 8 to 10 hours

cues.zh: 假设是10小时，那还剩8小时，然后你每天通勤大约一小时
cues.en: So, let's assume it's 10 hours so we have 8 hours left then you travel around an hour a day

cues.zh: 也许每天两小时，那你还剩六小时。那你用这六小时做什么呢？
cues.en: Maybe two hours a day. So now you have still six hours left. So what are you doing with this six hours?

cues.zh: 也许稍微吃点东西，稍微聊聊天
cues.en: Maybe eat a little bit. Maybe schmooze a little bit

cues.zh: 和人聊聊天之类的，但如果你把一天安排好，就能看出有多少时间可用
cues.en: Talk a little bit to people and all that stuff, but you can see how much time is available if you organize your day

cues.zh: 所以你得拼命干
cues.en: So you got the work hard

cues.zh: 我讨厌B计划
cues.en: I hate Plan B

cues.zh: 我告诉你为什么
cues.en: I tell you why

cues.zh: 因为正如我之前说的，我们有太多怀疑者，那些说不的人
cues.en: Because we have so many doubters as I've said earlier the no sayers

cues.zh: 我们有太多这样的人，他们说不行，你做不到，那不可能
cues.en: We have so many of those people who say no, you can't do it, that's impossible

cues.zh: 没关系，因为正如我之前说的，我们直接关掉，屏蔽掉
cues.en: That is okay because we just turn off as I said earlier and bees

cues.zh: 听着，把“不”听成“是”。你做不到，就去做。你能做到，诸如此类
cues.en: Listen and be hear that no being a yes. You can't do it do it. You can do it and all that

cues.zh: 所以这是可以做到的
cues.en: So that that is possible to do that

cues.zh: 在你周围全是消极的人时，但当你开始怀疑自己
cues.en: amongst all the negative people around you but when you start doubting yourself

cues.zh: 那非常危险，因为这时你基本上是在说，如果我的计划行不通
cues.en: That's very dangerous because now what you're basically saying is is that if my plan doesn't work

cues.zh: 我有个后备计划，我有B计划
cues.en: I have a fallback plan. I have a plan B

cues.zh: 这意味着你开始想着B计划，而你投入B计划的每一个念头
cues.en: And that means that you start thinking about Plan B and every thought that you put into Plan B

cues.zh: 都是在从A计划那里夺走那个念头和那份精力
cues.en: you're taking away now that thought and that energy from plan a

cues.zh: 这非常重要
cues.en: And it's very important

cues.zh: 要明白，我们表现更好
cues.en: To understand that we function better

cues.zh: 是在没有安全网的时候，因为B计划成了安全网。它说的是，如果我失败了
cues.en: If there is no safety net because Plan B becomes a safety net. It says that if I fail

cues.zh: 那就会跌倒，有人把我扶起来，我还有别的东西在那里，意味着他们会保护我
cues.en: Then a fall and I get picked up and I have something else there that means they will protect me

cues.zh: 这并不好，因为没有安全网时人们表现更好
cues.en: And that's not good because people perform better when there's no safety net

cues.zh: 在体育和一切事情上，如果没有B计划，人们表现更好
cues.en: People perform better in sports and everything else if you don't have a plan B

cues.zh: 我跟你说，我从来从来没有
cues.en: I'm telling you I've never ever

cues.zh: 过B计划，我
cues.en: had a plan B I

cues.zh: 我做出了完全的承诺，我要成为健美冠军。我做出了完全的承诺，我要去美国
cues.en: I made a full commitment that I'm gonna be a bodybuilding champion. I made a full commitment that I'm gonna be in America

cues.zh: 我做出了完全的承诺，我要进入演艺圈
cues.en: I made a full commitment that I'm gonna get in the show business

cues.zh: 我要成为男主角。不管付出什么代价，我都会去做。
cues.en: And I'm going to be a leading man. No matter what it takes. I will do the work.

cues.zh: 我会一遍一遍又一遍地去做，直到我做到为止
cues.en: I will do the work over and over and over, until I get it

cues.zh: 这和在政界以及类似领域是一样的。所以对我来说，这非常危险
cues.en: The same as in politics and everything like that. So to me, it is very dangerous

cues.zh: 有B计划，因为你切断了自己
cues.en: to have a plan B because you're cutting yourself off from

cues.zh: 真正成功的机会，而人们想要有B计划的主要原因之一
cues.en: the chance of really succeeding and the reason one of the main reasons why people want to have a plan B is

cues.zh: 是因为他们害怕失败
cues.en: Because they are worried about failing

cues.zh: 万一我失败了，那我就什么都没有了
cues.en: What is if I fail then I don't have anything else

cues.zh: 那好，让我告诉你一件事。不要害怕失败
cues.en: Well, let me tell you something. Don't be afraid of failing

cues.zh: 因为失败没什么大不了的
cues.en: Because there's nothing wrong with failing

cues.zh: 你必须失败，才能爬上那架梯子
cues.en: You have to fail in order to climb that ladder

cues.zh: 没有人不失败，迈克尔·乔丹在一次采访中说过
cues.en: There's no one that doesn't fail Michael Jordan said in one of his interviews

cues.zh: 当他们说“你太不可思议了，是有史以来最伟大的篮球运动员”
cues.en: When they said "you're unbelievable the greatest basketball player of all times"

cues.zh: 我是说，跟我讲讲吧。然后他说“嗯，你只提到了成功”
cues.en: I mean tell me about that. And then he said "Well, you just mentioned the successes"

cues.zh: 但他说“为了成为最伟大的篮球运动员，我投丢了”
cues.en: But he says "for me to become the greatest basketball player I missed"

cues.zh: “九千个球”
cues.en: "nine thousand shots"

cues.zh: “当我在NBA打篮球比赛的时候”
cues.en: "When I was playing basketball in the NBA games"

cues.zh: 所以在他如此成功的这些比赛中，他投丢了九千个球
cues.en: So during this games that he was so successful he missed nine thousand shots

cues.zh: 他算失败者吗？不，他是最伟大的篮球运动员之一，四次夺冠，但他失败过
cues.en: Does it make him a failure? No, he is one of the greatest basketball players are four times, but he failed

cues.zh: 9000次。明白吗？
cues.en: 9,000 times. Do you get it?

cues.zh: 我们都会失败。没关系。
cues.en: We all fail. It's okay.

cues.zh: 不行的是，失败后你就此一蹶不振
cues.en: What is not ok is when you fail you stay down

cues.zh: 一蹶不振的人才是输家
cues.en: Whoever stays down is a loser

cues.zh: 而赢家会失败再站起来，失败再站起来，失败再站起来，你总能站起来，这才是
cues.en: And winners will fail and get up fail and get up, fail and get up, you always get up that is

cues.zh: 赢家
cues.en: a winner

cues.zh: 这才是赢家
cues.en: That is a winner

cues.zh: 我在健美上失败过。我输过健美比赛
cues.en: I failed in bodybuilding. I lost bodybuilding competitions

cues.zh: 我输过力量举比赛，输过举重比赛
cues.en: I lost powerlifting competitions and lost weightlifting competitions

cues.zh: 我有些电影一塌糊涂，糟糕透顶，影评最差
cues.en: I had movies that went in the toilet that were terrible. It got the worst reviews

cues.zh: 在政治上，我记得我有很多提案和选票
cues.en: And in politics, I remember I had many of the initiatives and the ballot

cues.zh: 我们输了
cues.en: And we lost

cues.zh: 我在加州的支持率跌到28%，然后
cues.en: My approval rating in California went down to 28% and

cues.zh: 又回升了，我再次赢得州长选举
cues.en: Then it went back up again and I won again the governorship

cues.zh: 嘿，我们都会输
cues.en: Hey, we all lose

cues.zh: 如果你们都输过，这没关系，所以我说不要
cues.en: If you all have lost as this is okay, and this is why I say don't

cues.zh: 害怕失败，因为当你害怕失败时，你就会僵住
cues.en: Be worried about losing because when you're afraid of losing then you get frozen

cues.zh: 你会僵硬，无法放松。你必须放松才能发挥出色
cues.en: You get stiff you're not relaxed. You got to be in order to perform

cues.zh: 无论做什么，无论是拳击、工作还是思考
cues.en: Well in anything if it's in boxing or if it is on your job or with your thinking

cues.zh: 只有放松时才会发生
cues.en: Is only happening when you relax

cues.zh: 所以放松，失败没关系
cues.en: So relax, it's okay to fail

cues.zh: 让我们全力以赴，倾尽所有。这才是关键。所以不要害怕失败
cues.en: Let's just go all out and give it everything that you got. That's what it is all about. So don't be afraid to fail
